translations.text: %@ تصطدم باللوح الحجري نازلةً، فيقذفها اللوح إلى الأعلى بعيدًا عن الجوخ.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@ trifft die Schieferplatte nach unten, und die Platte wirft sie wieder hoch, vom Tuch weg.

translations.text: %@ golpea la pizarra al bajar, y la pizarra la lanza de nuevo hacia arriba, fuera del paño.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@ frappe l'ardoise en descendant, et l'ardoise la renvoie vers le haut, hors du tapis.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@ colpisce l'ardesia scendendo, e l'ardesia la rilancia verso l'alto, via dal panno.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@は下向きにスレートに当たり、スレートに跳ね上げられてラシャから離れます。

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@(이)가 내려가며 슬레이트에 부딪히고, 슬레이트가 다시 위로 튕겨 올려 천에서 떠오릅니다.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@ bate na ardósia a descer, e a ardósia atira-a de novo para cima, para fora do pano.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@ bate na ardósia descendo, e a ardósia a joga de volta para cima, para fora do pano.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@ ударяется о плиту, двигаясь вниз, и плита подбрасывает его вверх, над сукном.

translations.key: %@ hits the slate going down, and the slate throws it back up off the cloth.
translations.text: %@ 向下撞上石板，石板又把它向上弹起，离开了台呢。
